name: docs-governance
description: Portable documentation governance: three routing gates, knowledge layers, writing style, and review workflow. Copied verbatim into repositories at docs/dev/documentation/.

protocol_history.summary: Three routing gates (time, audience, cognitive mode) with root-files exception; repository contracts split from adoption; knowledge-layers page; postmortem workflow in update/review checklists; manifest for drift detection.
Flat Diataxis decision list, adoption held repository contracts, common-docs pattern library, AGENTS.md maintainer rule.

update_policy: Semantic versioning on protocol_version. MAJOR: a repository following the old protocol would be non-compliant without migration work. MINOR: new optional pages or sections; old content stays valid. PATCH: clarifications and typo-level changes that do not alter any rule.

roles.guide: Governance prose; must match the standard byte for byte.
roles.checklist: Review and update procedures; must match the standard byte for byte.
roles.guard: Maintainer and AI policy; must match the standard byte for byte.
roles.library: Reusable document patterns; must match the standard byte for byte.
roles.template: Shipped as a template, customized per repository. Editable files are excluded from integrity checks; sync refreshes them only when the standard's template itself changed, so local customization survives upgrades.

distribution.install: Copy standard/ contents into <repo>/docs/dev/documentation/. Run tools/verify.sh against the repository.
distribution.upgrade: Run tools/sync.sh <repo>. Editable files keep their local version unless the standard template changed; a note is printed for manual merge.
distribution.verify: tools/verify.sh compares every non-editable sha256 against this manifest; exits nonzero with a per-file report on drift.
